title: Spicy Chicken Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish that combines the spices of Tunisian cuisine with the richness of nutty basmati rice and tender chicken.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Tunisian spice blend to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice blend.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the cilantro.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the rice.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
